|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">旧型の通訳用ドロイド。ナーラ中佐のために働きながら軍事戦術を学んだ。エコー基地のドロイド置き場の管理を任されている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' K-3PO (Kay-Threepio).

'''Card text:'''
May declare battle and be battled. On Hoth or Yavin 4, K-3PO is power +1 for each of your droids at the same location. If at least one other of your droids is at the same place, it functions as a leader.

'''Lore:'''
Old-model interpreter droid. It learned military tactics while working for Commander Narra. It is in charge of the droid storage at Echo Base.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 通訳用ドロイド.
